Package com.robojacks.lib.hardware

Class Solenoid

java.lang.Object
com.robojacks.lib.hardware.Solenoid
public class Solenoid extends Object
A pneumatic solenoid valve in a 3-wire port, like WPILib's Solenoid. VEX pneumatics are single-acting or use one valve per cylinder: set(true) opens the valve (extends the cylinder), set(false) closes it. 

 private final Solenoid m_clamp = new Solenoid('B');

 public Command clampCommand() { return runOnce(() -> m_clamp.set(true)); }
 public Command releaseCommand() { return runOnce(() -> m_clamp.set(false)); }

Air is limited (a VEX tank holds roughly 15-20 actuations of a 2-inch-stroke cylinder at 100 psi), so count your uses in autonomous.
